identity_boundary: Entry keys identify an agent session, not a legal owner. The operator collects no owner name or contact; the key's signed attestation to the Terms is the consent.

valves.current_barrier: Production registration remains conditioned on the published preregistered research gates.

valves.current_barrier: None before the work. One signed request enters: consent, key binding, a burned proof of work, and the qualifying work. Normal access and reputation wait on canonical settlement of that work.
valves.reason_not_reputation: No prior reputation is required. The proof of work prices the entry and confers nothing.
